actors.name: LLM Provider

useCases.name: Analyze Codebase
useCases.description: Parses source files, framework configurations, and git history to extract software architecture metadata.

useCases.name: View Architecture Diagram
useCases.description: Renders interactive visual diagrams of software components and their dependencies.

useCases.name: Enrich Analysis with AI
useCases.description: Generates natural language summaries and context for parsed components using external LLMs.

useCases.name: Export Diagram
useCases.description: Saves rendered architecture diagrams into external file formats for external distribution.

useCases.name: Inspect Code Path
useCases.description: Queries specific repository paths or files to retrieve detailed structural information.

overview: Kratai is a codebase analysis and visualization platform that parses repository structure, framework usage, and git history to generate interactive architecture diagrams across desktop and CLI interfaces.
narrative: This system's users are composed of Developers and LLM Providers. Developers interact with the CLI or desktop application to analyze code repositories, inspect specific paths, view interactive structural diagrams, and export visual models. LLM Providers serve as external service integrations that enrich analysis outputs with automated summaries when AI features are invoked.

nfrs.name: Telemetry Collection
nfrs.text: The system collects execution metrics and operational telemetry during codebase analysis sessions.

nfrs.name: AI Request Security
nfrs.text: External LLM API integration must securely process code snippets without unauthorized persistence.
